sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界，并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Kim Severson, a reporter on the Food Desk.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是美食版记者金·塞弗森。

sentences.en: People who listen to The Daily might remember me from our Thanksgiving venture into the history of bad ways to cook your turkey.
sentences.zh: 听过《每日》节目的听众可能还记得，感恩节时我们曾探讨过烹饪火鸡的各种糟糕方法。

sentences.en: The air fryer's awesome.
sentences.zh: 空气炸锅太棒了。

sentences.en: Okay, but seriously, can you put a turkey in an air fryer?
sentences.zh: 好吧，说真的，你能用空气炸锅烤火鸡吗？

sentences.en: A whole turkey, no.
sentences.zh: 整只火鸡的话，不行。

sentences.en: Well, I'm back and I have something new that I think you're going to like.
sentences.zh: 好了，我回来了，而且我带来了一些我认为你会喜欢的新东西。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Listen, we're going to make it work.
sentences.zh: 听着，我们会搞定的。

sentences.en: It's like jazz.
sentences.zh: 这就像爵士乐一样。

sentences.en: We've been working on a brand spanking new audio project here at The Times.
sentences.zh: 我们《纽约时报》正在制作一个全新的音频项目。

sentences.en: And it's designed to help you dig into the nooks and crannies of culture you might not have explored before.
sentences.zh: 它的设计初衷是帮助你深入挖掘那些你可能从未探索过的文化角落。

sentences.en: Maybe listen to some new kinds of music.
sentences.zh: 也许去听听一些新类型的音乐。

sentences.en: She's what's next.
sentences.zh: 她就是未来之星。

sentences.en: She is what's new.
sentences.zh: 她就是新潮流。

sentences.en: Put it on the bucket liSt.
sentences.zh: 把它列入愿望清单吧。

sentences.en: Maybe pick up a new book.
sentences.zh: 也许去读一本新书。

sentences.en: I just started crying while reading to my child.
sentences.zh: 我刚才给孩子读书时突然哭了起来。

sentences.en: Cook a new recipe.
sentences.zh: 尝试做一道新菜。

sentences.en: Well, what if I just dump some of the hot water over the basil?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果我直接把热水倒在罗勒上会怎样？

sentences.en: Mmm, it smells great.
sentences.zh: 嗯，闻起来真香。

sentences.en: Or just think differently about something you do every day.
sentences.zh: 或者对你每天做的事情换个角度思考。

sentences.en: You can shake things up in an instant, which is something that I think that we forget.
sentences.zh: 你可以瞬间改变现状，这一点我们往往会忘记。

sentences.en: I'll be here for the next few Saturdays to give you a sample of what we're calling NYT shorts.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几个周六我都会在这里，为大家带来我们称之为“时报短篇”的节目片段。

sentences.en: These stories are short, sweet bites delivered to you direct from our critics and reporters.
sentences.zh: 这些故事是由我们的评论员和记者直接为你带来的短小精悍的内容。

sentences.en: Hello, my name is Jason Zinneman.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是杰森·齐内曼。

sentences.en: I'm Katie Weaver.
sentences.zh: 我是凯蒂·韦弗。

sentences.en: My name is Benji Park.
sentences.zh: 我叫本吉·帕克。

sentences.en: I'm Maya Phillips.
sentences.zh: 我是玛雅·菲利普斯。

sentences.en: My name is MJ Franklin.
sentences.zh: 我叫MJ·富兰克林。

sentences.en: I'm Manola Dargis.
sentences.zh: 我是曼诺拉·达吉斯。

sentences.en: You can find them on our new app, NYT Audio, which is out now.
sentences.zh: 你可以在我们刚刚发布的新应用“NYT Audio”上找到它们。

sentences.en: Okay, so here we go.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们开始吧。

sentences.en: First up, my colleague, Elizabeth Vincentelli, who covers performing arts for The Times.
sentences.zh: 首先是我的同事伊丽莎白·文森特利，她负责《时报》的表演艺术报道。

sentences.en: She recently rediscovered an old childhood favorite, the television show Columbo.
sentences.zh: 她最近重温了童年最爱的一部电视剧——《神探可伦坡》。

sentences.en: I started watching Columbo with my dad.
sentences.zh: 我开始看《神探可伦坡》是因为我爸爸。

sentences.en: I must have been around, I want to say 13 or 14, and we would watch TV together on weekend afternoons.
sentences.zh: 那时我大概13或14岁，我们会在周末下午一起看电视。

sentences.en: My name is Columbo.
sentences.zh: 我叫可伦坡。

sentences.en: I'm a lieutenant from the police.
sentences.zh: 我是警察局的警探。

sentences.en: We both loved mysteries, and Columbo was one of our favorites.
sentences.zh: 我们都喜欢悬疑剧，《神探可伦坡》是我们的最爱之一。

sentences.en: Is there another way out of this house?
sentences.zh: 这房子还有别的出口吗？

sentences.en: By water.
sentences.zh: 走水路。

sentences.en: The general's got a yacht in the slip back of the house.
sentences.zh: 将军在房子后面的码头停了一艘游艇。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: We love watching that show, and I sometimes wonder if it's not because he was driving a French car.
sentences.zh: 我们很喜欢看这部剧，我有时会想，是不是因为他开的是一辆法国车。

sentences.en: This isn't a department car, is it?
sentences.zh: 这不是警局的车，对吧？

sentences.en: No, this is mine.
sentences.zh: 不，这是我自己的车。

sentences.en: He drives a Peugeot, and we had a Peugeot.
sentences.zh: 他开的是标致，我们也有一辆标致。

sentences.en: It had no air conditioning, and it was incredibly hot in summer, and we would stick to the plastic seats.
sentences.zh: 它没有空调，夏天热得要命，我们总是粘在塑料座椅上。

sentences.en: It was horribly uncomfortable, but we had the same car as Columbo, like total bond right there.
sentences.zh: 虽然很不舒服，但我们和可伦坡开一样的车，这简直是一种奇妙的羁绊。

sentences.en: Do you ever consider getting another car?
sentences.zh: 你有没有考虑过换辆车？

sentences.en: I did not really think about Columbo for decades until 2020, the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 直到2020年疫情期间，我才真正想起可伦坡。

sentences.en: And I have no idea from what murky area of my brain this came, but I felt I want to watch Columbo again.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这念头是从大脑哪个角落冒出来的，但我就是想再看一遍《神探可伦坡》。

sentences.en: We watching Columbo felt like such, it was like going into a warm bath.
sentences.zh: 看《神探可伦坡》的感觉就像泡了个热水澡一样舒服。

sentences.en: My name is Elizabeth Finchantelli.
sentences.zh: 我叫伊丽莎白·文森特利。

sentences.en: I write for the Arts Pages, and I love Columbo.
sentences.zh: 我为艺术版撰稿，我热爱《神探可伦坡》。

sentences.en: I am not ashamed.
sentences.zh: 我一点也不觉得丢人。

sentences.en: Columbo was created in late 1960s, and it's about a California detective who's played by Peter Falk.
sentences.zh: 《神探可伦坡》创作于20世纪60年代末，讲述了一位由彼得·福克饰演的加州警探的故事。

sentences.en: And Columbo has a very, some might say, formulaic structure.
sentences.zh: 可伦坡的剧集结构非常……有人可能会说是公式化。

sentences.en: I like to think of it as tried and true.
sentences.zh: 我更愿意称之为久经考验的经典。

sentences.en: So it's not possible to spoil Columbo, because each episode of Columbo always followed the same structure.
sentences.zh: 所以《神探可伦坡》是不可能被剧透的，因为每一集都遵循同样的结构。

sentences.en: We see the entire murder firSt.
sentences.zh: 我们一开始就看到了整个谋杀过程。

sentences.en: We see the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了全部经过。

sentences.en: And then we see the cover-up.
sentences.zh: 然后我们看到凶手如何掩盖罪行。

sentences.en: That's a list of some of the top men in organized crime on the West CoaSt.
sentences.zh: 这是一份西海岸有组织犯罪头目的名单。

sentences.en: One of these men had Jim killed.
sentences.zh: 这些人里有人杀了吉姆。

sentences.en: But we realize as we go along that we actually are not seeing the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 但随着剧情推进，我们意识到其实我们并没有看到全部真相。

sentences.en: The murderer has usually forgotten some key details that someone is going to bring up.
sentences.zh: 凶手通常会遗漏一些关键细节，而有人会把这些细节提出来。

sentences.en: And that someone is Lieutenant Columbo.
sentences.zh: 那个人就是可伦坡警探。

sentences.en: Who are you?
sentences.zh: 你是谁？

sentences.en: My name is Columbo.
sentences.zh: 我叫可伦坡。

sentences.en: I'm a lieutenant.
sentences.zh: 我是警探。

sentences.en: Whose main attribute, I would say, is rumpled.
sentences.zh: 我认为他最主要的特征就是“褶皱感”。

sentences.en: It feels like everything about him is rumpled.
sentences.zh: 他整个人看起来都皱皱巴巴的。

sentences.en: His clothes are rumpled.
sentences.zh: 他的衣服是皱的。

sentences.en: His hair feels rumpled.
sentences.zh: 他的头发看起来也是乱糟糟的。

sentences.en: His speech feels rumpled.
sentences.zh: 他的说话方式也显得拖泥带水。

sentences.en: Something else was in there.
sentences.zh: 还有别的东西在里面。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: What do you think it was?
sentences.zh: 你觉得那是什么？

sentences.en: One, two, three, four, five, six.
sentences.zh: 一、二、三、四、五、六。

sentences.en: He has this very odd slouch.
sentences.zh: 他有一种非常奇怪的站姿。

sentences.en: He walks almost kind of hunched.
sentences.zh: 他走路时总是有点驼背。

sentences.en: Whenever I see a pretty young girl like you doing all that smoking, I say to myself, why does she take the chance?
sentences.zh: 每当我看到像你这么漂亮的年轻女孩抽烟，我就会想，为什么要冒这个险呢？

sentences.en: Often, he smokes a cigar that you just know smells disgusting.
sentences.zh: 他经常抽一支你一闻就知道味道很恶心的雪茄。

sentences.en: You can just tell.
sentences.zh: 你一眼就能看出来。

sentences.en: Hey, wait a minute.
sentences.zh: 嘿，等一下。

sentences.en: Nice cigar.
sentences.zh: 好雪茄。

sentences.en: And the classic Columbo villain is rich and or powerful, whether it's like a chess master or a chef or there's a conductor who actually is powerful and rich.
sentences.zh: 典型的《神探可伦坡》反派通常既富有又有权势，无论是国际象棋大师、厨师，还是权势显赫的指挥家。

sentences.en: I'm fascinated by money, aren't you?
sentences.zh: 我对金钱很着迷，你呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm fascinated by money, for what it can do, that's all.
sentences.zh: 是的，我对金钱很着迷，因为它能做到的事，仅此而已。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: They think they can get whatever they want.
sentences.zh: 他们以为自己可以为所欲为。

sentences.en: And then this guy, this guy in his rumpled clothing, turns up and wrecks their beautiful plan.
sentences.zh: 然后这个穿着皱巴巴衣服的家伙出现了，毁了他们完美的计划。

sentences.en: Some men, Lieutenant, do not want to look like an unmade bed.
sentences.zh: 有些人，警探，是不想让自己看起来像张没铺好的床。

sentences.en: Columbo is an unconventional detective.
sentences.zh: 可伦坡是一位非传统的警探。

sentences.en: He is such a normie detective in many ways that it becomes completely extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 他在很多方面都表现得如此平凡，以至于显得格外非凡。

sentences.en: This guy solves a complicated case with nothing else but his brain.
sentences.zh: 这家伙只靠大脑就破获了复杂的案件。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 仅此而已。

sentences.en: He turns up at the scene of the crime and he starts asking questions.
sentences.zh: 他出现在犯罪现场，开始问各种问题。

sentences.en: You don't mind if I ask you a personal question, do you?
sentences.zh: 你不介意我问个私人问题吧？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不介意。

sentences.en: What'd you pay for those shoes?
sentences.zh: 这双鞋你花了多少钱？

sentences.en: I think about $60.
sentences.zh: 我想大概60美元吧。

sentences.en: I stepped into some water yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天踩到水里了。

sentences.en: I have a roll in mine.
sentences.zh: 我的鞋里进水了。

sentences.en: You don't know where I could get a pair that looks like that for around $16 or $17.
sentences.zh: 你知不知道哪里能买到看起来像这样，但只要16或17美元的鞋？

sentences.en: And he keeps hovering around.
sentences.zh: 他总是徘徊在周围。

sentences.en: You do whatever you have to do and I'll just tag along and don't you worry about it.
sentences.zh: 你忙你的，我跟着就行，别担心我。

sentences.en: And asking questions that don't seem to make much sense.
sentences.zh: 问一些看似毫无意义的问题。

sentences.en: Say, what kind of nightlife do you have around here?
sentences.zh: 对了，你们这儿有什么夜生活吗？

sentences.en: Nightlife?
sentences.zh: 夜生活？

sentences.en: None.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No ponying?
sentences.zh: 没有聚会？

sentences.en: He was always looking like, oh, um, well what about this?
sentences.zh: 他总是表现得像，“哦，嗯，那这个呢？”

sentences.en: I'll tell you what I was curious about.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你我好奇的是什么。

sentences.en: Do you have a moment?
sentences.zh: 你有空吗？

sentences.en: Well, what about that?
sentences.zh: 那么，那个呢？

sentences.en: Is this a copy?
sentences.zh: 这是复制品吗？

sentences.en: It's just sort of one thing.
sentences.zh: 这只是其中一件事。

sentences.en: You own this?
sentences.zh: 这是你的吗？

sentences.en: But I'm not sure I understand.
sentences.zh: 但我不太确定我听懂了。

sentences.en: I don't quite follow what you're saying.
sentences.zh: 我不太明白你在说什么。

sentences.en: Can you explain to me what's happening?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我解释一下发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: You always wear a beauty mark.
sentences.zh: 你总是戴着一颗美人痣。

sentences.en: Only this morning you don't have an arm.
sentences.zh: 怎么今天早上你却没有了？

sentences.en: I don't understand.
sentences.zh: 我不明白。

sentences.en: Isn't it funny how people are different?
sentences.zh: 人与人之间真是不同，这难道不有趣吗？

sentences.en: Now me, if I found my partner dead, I'd never think of opening my letters.
sentences.zh: 要是换做我，如果发现我的搭档死了，我绝不会想到去拆信件。

sentences.en: I'm just not getting this.
sentences.zh: 我就是搞不懂这一点。

sentences.en: Can you please explain to me?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我解释一下吗？

sentences.en: Which is, of course, the greatest trap of all.
sentences.zh: 这当然是最大的陷阱。

sentences.en: It's basically a hunting show.
sentences.zh: 这本质上是一部狩猎剧。

sentences.en: It really is like the most laid-back hunting show ever, based entirely on talk.
sentences.zh: 这确实是有史以来最悠闲的狩猎剧，完全靠谈话进行。

sentences.en: And at the end, big reveal, he pretty much explains to them how they did it.
sentences.zh: 最后，大揭秘时刻，他几乎向他们解释了他们是如何作案的。

sentences.en: Columbo, what the hell are you doing?
sentences.zh: 可伦坡，你到底在干什么？

sentences.en: Oh, just a little phone demonstration, sir, to show how a man who's already dead can appear to be alive.
sentences.zh: 哦，只是个小小的电话演示，先生，为了展示一个已经死掉的人如何看起来还活着。

sentences.en: So the whole point of the show is not who did it, or even how they did it, because we know that.
sentences.zh: 所以节目的重点根本不是谁干的，甚至不是他们怎么干的，因为我们已经知道了。

sentences.en: It's how he's going to get them.
sentences.zh: 重点是他打算怎么对付他们。

sentences.en: You know what I found out?
sentences.zh: 你知道我发现了什么吗？

sentences.en: They actually use poisons when they make cosmetics.
sentences.zh: 他们制造化妆品时竟然会用毒药。

sentences.en: And that's just the best feeling in the world.
sentences.zh: 这感觉真是棒极了。

sentences.en: Very good, Lieutenant.
sentences.zh: 非常好，中尉。

sentences.en: It's very reassuring for the order of the world.
sentences.zh: 这对维持世界秩序来说非常令人安心。

sentences.en: And I get it.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: Not everything is for everybody.
sentences.zh: 并不是所有东西都适合所有人。

sentences.en: Columbo is my jam.
sentences.zh: 《神探可伦坡》是我的心头好。

sentences.en: It's a lot of people's jam.
sentences.zh: 很多人都喜欢它。

sentences.en: People often say, oh, the kind of poo-poo, it's comfort food, or it's just a sandwich.
sentences.zh: 人们常说，噢，那种东西，不过是慰藉食品，或者只是个三明治。

sentences.en: Well, this is a really good sandwich.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这确实是个非常棒的三明治。

sentences.en: Oh, this is delicious.
sentences.zh: 噢，太好吃了。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我爱死它了。

sentences.en: Okay, a sandwich might be great to eat in front of the television.
sentences.zh: 好吧，在电视机前吃个三明治可能很棒。

sentences.en: But if we're talking about nostalgic TV, we have to talk about nostalgic food, too.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们谈论的是怀旧电视，那我们也得谈谈怀旧美食。

sentences.en: For me, you got to go with a bowl of pasta.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，你得来上一碗意面。

sentences.en: And I know just the guy to teach you how to make it.
sentences.zh: 而且我知道有个人正好能教你怎么做。

sentences.en: My pal, Sam.
sentences.zh: 我的伙伴，萨姆。

sentences.en: Think of him as your dinner coach.
sentences.zh: 把他当作你的晚餐教练吧。

sentences.en: Tonight, you should make ham and cheese pasta with a fistful of peas.
sentences.zh: 今晚，你应该做一份火腿奶酪意面，再加一把豌豆。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Sifton, an assistant managing editor of The New York Times and the founding editor of New York Times Cooking.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·西夫顿，《纽约时报》助理执行编辑，也是《纽约时报》烹饪栏目的创刊编辑。

sentences.en: Here's some comfort food of the first order.
sentences.zh: 这可是顶级的慰藉食品。

sentences.en: It's like you're seven years old eating this dish.
sentences.zh: 吃这道菜的时候，感觉就像回到了七岁。

sentences.en: And yeah, yeah, it's ham, it's cheese, it's peas, it's pasta.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是火腿、奶酪、豌豆和意面。

sentences.en: But together, there's a kind of alchemy that happens that delivers you to a place of immense comfort and joy.
sentences.zh: 但它们组合在一起，产生了一种炼金术般的反应，把你带入一个充满慰藉与喜悦的境地。

sentences.en: It's like a hug.
sentences.zh: 就像一个拥抱。

sentences.en: A lot happens in this dish all at once.
sentences.zh: 这道菜里同时发生了很多事。

sentences.en: And so I think the first and most important thing is to, and I hate to sound fancy, but is to set up what they call a mise en place.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为第一件也是最重要的事情是——我不想显得太讲究——就是准备好所谓的“备料”。

sentences.en: That is, get all the ingredients that you need to make the dish out on the counter in front of you.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，把你做这道菜所需的所有食材都摆在面前的台面上。

sentences.en: And there are not many of them.
sentences.zh: 而且食材并不多。

sentences.en: You have a box of shells.
sentences.zh: 你有一盒贝壳面。

sentences.en: What size shells?
sentences.zh: 什么尺寸的贝壳面？

sentences.en: Not too big.
sentences.zh: 不要太大。

sentences.en: Large shells?
sentences.zh: 大贝壳面？

sentences.en: Not the huge ones?
sentences.zh: 不是那种巨大的？

sentences.en: Not like the stuffed shells kind.
sentences.zh: 不是那种用来塞馅的。

sentences.en: The ones that are about the size of a knuckle?
sentences.zh: 大概指关节那么大的那种？

sentences.en: The little shells kind.
sentences.zh: 小贝壳面那种。

sentences.en: Full of Cuba ham kind.
sentences.zh: 那种塞满古巴火腿的。

sentences.en: Shells.
sentences.zh: 贝壳面。

sentences.en: Ham steak.
sentences.zh: 火腿排。

sentences.en: What's a ham steak?
sentences.zh: 什么是火腿排？

sentences.en: It's just a thick slice of ham.
sentences.zh: 就是厚切的一片火腿。

sentences.en: I never bought a ham steak before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从没买过火腿排。

sentences.en: Me neither, I didn't know it was a thing.
sentences.zh: 我也没买过，我甚至不知道还有这种东西。

sentences.en: You can find it at the butcher, you can find it in the case at the supermarket, and you just dice that into nice little cubes.
sentences.zh: 你可以在肉铺找到它，也可以在超市的冷柜里找到，只要把它切成漂亮的小方块就行。

sentences.en: So, you've got your shells, you've got your ham, you've got your cheese.
sentences.zh: 所以，你有贝壳面，有火腿，还有奶酪。

sentences.en: Generally, I call for like a good Swiss, but what does that really mean?
sentences.zh: 通常我会推荐用好的瑞士奶酪，但这到底意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: You know what is an excellent cheese for this dish?
sentences.zh: 你知道这道菜用什么奶酪最棒吗？

sentences.en: Good old Jarlsberg, because it melts like a dream, really easy to work with.
sentences.zh: 老牌的杰尔斯堡奶酪，因为它融化起来简直完美，非常好用。

sentences.en: It's available in every store, probably on the planet.
sentences.zh: 它在地球上几乎每家店都能买到。

sentences.en: And then your peas.
sentences.zh: 然后是你的豌豆。

sentences.en: Peas, please.
sentences.zh: 豌豆，拜托了。

sentences.en: And for peas, again, I'm going to sound like a fancy pants.
sentences.zh: 说到豌豆，我又要显得很讲究了。

sentences.en: I hate myself for this sometimes.
sentences.zh: 有时候我真讨厌自己这样。

sentences.en: But I think you want to go with the organic frozen peas.
sentences.zh: 但我认为你最好选有机冷冻豌豆。

sentences.en: And I got the organic kind.
sentences.zh: 我买的就是有机的。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because they're sweeter.
sentences.zh: 因为它们更甜。

sentences.en: Okay, so you have all your ingredients ready to go.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在所有食材都准备就绪了。

sentences.en: Now it's time to cook.
sentences.zh: 是时候开火了。

sentences.en: Set a pot of salted water on a high burner and get it up to boil.
sentences.zh: 在炉灶上放一锅加了盐的水，开大火烧开。

sentences.en: That's what you're going to use to cook your pasta.
sentences.zh: 那是用来煮意面的。

sentences.en: The pasta's going to take, what, 8 to 12 minutes?
sentences.zh: 意面大概需要，嗯，8到12分钟？

sentences.en: So, while it's in there, you want to brown your diced ham.
sentences.zh: 所以，在煮的时候，你要把切好的火腿丁煎成褐色。

sentences.en: How to do that?
sentences.zh: 怎么做呢？

sentences.en: Put a skillet on the stove.
sentences.zh: 在炉子上放个平底锅。

sentences.en: Medium-high heat.
sentences.zh: 中大火。

sentences.en: Big old pat of butter.
sentences.zh: 放一大块黄油。

sentences.en: When it starts to foam, get the ham in there.
sentences.zh: 当它开始起泡时，把火腿放进去。

sentences.en: Spread it out over the skillet.
sentences.zh: 在锅里铺开。

sentences.en: Let it brown.
sentences.zh: 让它煎出焦色。

sentences.en: Toss it a few times.
sentences.zh: 翻炒几次。

sentences.en: Let it brown some more.
sentences.zh: 再煎一会儿。

sentences.en: Won't take forever.
sentences.zh: 用不了多久。

sentences.en: One dump.
sentences.zh: 一股脑倒进去。

sentences.en: That's the ham.
sentences.zh: 这就是火腿。

sentences.en: When they start hopping out of the pans, they're done.
sentences.zh: 当它们开始在锅里跳动时，就熟了。

sentences.en: Third thing you have to do, grate that cheese.
sentences.zh: 第三步，把奶酪擦成丝。

sentences.en: Doesn't have to be pretty, right?
sentences.zh: 不需要弄得很好看，对吧？

sentences.en: Nope.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Simple stuff.
sentences.zh: 简单的活儿。

sentences.en: Doesn't need to be beautiful because it's all going to melt.
sentences.zh: 不需要很漂亮，因为反正都要融化掉。

sentences.en: This is going to be some very cheesy pasta.
sentences.zh: 这会是一份奶酪味十足的意面。

sentences.en: And finally, you have the peas.
sentences.zh: 最后，是豌豆。

sentences.en: I like, myself, to cook them just for a few moments in the pasta water, just before I'm going to drain the pasta.
sentences.zh: 我个人喜欢在沥干意面之前，把它们在煮面水里烫一会儿。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好了。

sentences.en: Peas in.
sentences.zh: 放入豌豆。

sentences.en: Saves a pot.
sentences.zh: 省一个锅。

sentences.en: Doesn't get them overcooked.
sentences.zh: 也不会煮过头。

sentences.en: And then you can take your drained pasta and peas, put it in a big bowl with the shredded cheese, add the ham.
sentences.zh: 然后把沥干的意面和豌豆倒进大碗里，加入奶酪丝，再放进火腿。

sentences.en: No stealing ham, mister.
sentences.zh: 不许偷吃火腿，先生。

sentences.en: Mix it all around, and then look down at this creation.
sentences.zh: 搅拌均匀，然后看看这道杰作。

sentences.en: Look at the pink of the ham, the green vibrancy of the peas,
sentences.zh: 看看火腿的粉色，豌豆鲜亮的绿色，

sentences.en: beautiful, melting, ivory color of the cheese.
sentences.zh: 还有奶酪那美丽、融化后的象牙色。

sentences.en: So much oozy cheese.
sentences.zh: 满满都是拉丝的奶酪。

sentences.en: And finally, those glistening shells holding, if you're lucky, a single pea or a single piece of ham in it.
sentences.zh: 最后，那些闪闪发光的贝壳面里，如果运气好，还能藏着一颗豌豆或一小块火腿。

sentences.en: Yeah, pasta.
sentences.zh: 没错，这就是意面。

sentences.en: You're sitting pretty.
sentences.zh: 你现在感觉很舒服。

sentences.en: You're like a child wrapped up in a blankie.
sentences.zh: 就像个裹在毯子里的小孩。

sentences.en: Eating delicious food.
sentences.zh: 吃着美味的食物。

sentences.en: More ham.
sentences.zh: 再来点火腿。

sentences.en: More ham.
sentences.zh: 再来点火腿。

sentences.en: Yeah, look, there's more ham there.
sentences.zh: 看，那儿还有火腿。

sentences.en: You gotta eat the pasta, too, honey, not just the ham.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的，你得吃点意面，不能光吃火腿。

sentences.en: And it tastes like childhood and happiness.
sentences.zh: 这味道尝起来就像童年和幸福。

sentences.en: Delicious.
sentences.zh: 美味。

sentences.en: Okay, next up, some tunes.
sentences.zh: 好了，接下来，听点音乐。

sentences.en: Every week, our brilliant music team comes through dozens of new songs, so you don't have to.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们出色的音乐团队都会从几十首新歌中精挑细选，这样你就不用自己去翻了。

sentences.en: Here is this week's playliSt.
sentences.zh: 这是本周的歌单。

sentences.en: I'm John Perelis, the chief pop music critic of the New York Times, with some new music to enjoy this weekend.
sentences.zh: 我是约翰·佩雷利斯，《纽约时报》首席流行音乐评论员，带给你一些周末可以享受的新音乐。

sentences.en: We've got the latest release from a pop superstar, the return of a post-punk legend, some music to move your feet, and more.
sentences.zh: 我们有流行巨星的最新单曲、后朋克传奇的回归、让你动起来的音乐，等等。

sentences.en: Ed Sheeran has a new album out.
sentences.zh: 艾德·希兰出新专辑了。

sentences.en: It's called Subtract.
sentences.zh: 名字叫《Subtract》。

sentences.en: It's produced by Aaron Dessner from The National, who's probably better known now as the co-producer of Taylor Swift's albums,
sentences.zh: 由The National乐队的亚伦·德斯纳制作，他现在可能更出名的是作为泰勒·斯威夫特专辑的联合制作人，

sentences.en: Folklore, and Evermore.
sentences.zh: 比如《Folklore》和《Evermore》。

sentences.en: Sadness always finds an end
sentences.zh: 悲伤总会迎来终点

sentences.en: This track, called Borderline, is in the same introspective zone as those Swift albums, and it's about facing some dark moments and trying to move on.
sentences.zh: 这首名为《Borderline》的曲子，和斯威夫特那些专辑一样处于内省的领域，讲述的是面对黑暗时刻并试图继续前行。

sentences.en: And every chapter has an end
sentences.zh: 每个篇章都有终点

sentences.en: Last year, Sheeran lost his best friend, Jamal Edwards.
sentences.zh: 去年，希兰失去了他最好的朋友贾马尔·爱德华兹。

sentences.en: Edwards got Sheeran onto YouTube and was crucial to getting his career started.
sentences.zh: 爱德华兹把希兰带到了YouTube上，对他事业的起步至关重要。

sentences.en: All the way through the song, you can hear Sheeran trying to pay his respects and hold on to find his balance between sorrow and survival.
sentences.zh: 整首歌里，你能听到希兰试图表达敬意，并努力在悲伤与生存之间寻找平衡。

sentences.en: That's Ed Sheeran with Borderline.
sentences.zh: 以上就是艾德·希兰的《Borderline》。

sentences.en: This next track is Para Mover Los Pies by Daimei Arosena.
sentences.zh: 下一首是黛梅·阿罗塞纳的《Para Mover Los Pies》。

sentences.en: The title of the song translates as to move your feet.
sentences.zh: 歌名翻译过来就是“动动你的双脚”。

sentences.en: But the song isn't just about dancing.
sentences.zh: 但这首歌不仅仅是关于跳舞。

sentences.en: It's actually a song of exile.
sentences.zh: 它实际上是一首关于流亡的歌。

sentences.en: Daimei Arosena grew up in Cuba, steeped in Afro-Cuban traditions, but she got away from the island four years ago.
sentences.zh: 黛梅·阿罗塞纳在古巴长大，深受非裔古巴传统熏陶，但她在四年前离开了那个岛屿。

sentences.en: She found her way to Puerto Rico, which has its own Afro-Caribbean culture.
sentences.zh: 她来到了波多黎各，那里有着属于自己的非裔加勒比文化。

sentences.en: Mi pueblo está sometido, temen al tintador.
sentences.zh: 我的民族正遭受压迫，他们畏惧独裁者。

sentences.en: In the lyrics to this song, Arosena bluntly denounces Cuba's dictatorship and she urges Cubans to fight for your freedom so that Cuba and Puerto Rico dance again.
sentences.zh: 在这首歌的歌词中，阿罗塞纳直言不讳地谴责了古巴的独裁统治，并敦促古巴人为了自由而战，让古巴和波多黎各再次舞动起来。

sentences.en: That was Daimei Arosena with Para Mover Los Pies.
sentences.zh: 刚才那是黛梅·阿罗塞纳的《Para Mover Los Pies》。

sentences.en: Theodora Laird from London has stripped her performing name down to FEO, F-E-E-O.
sentences.zh: 来自伦敦的西奥多拉·莱尔德将她的艺名简化为FEO，F-E-E-O。

sentences.en: This new song, Iris, unfolds more like a soliloquy than a song, as if it's extrapolating from the jazziest impulses of Joni Mitchell.
sentences.zh: 这首新歌《Iris》展开时更像是一段独白而非歌曲，仿佛是从琼尼·米歇尔最爵士的灵感中延伸出来的。

sentences.en: There was a time when we breathed out and dreamed of...
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，我们呼出气息，梦想着……

sentences.en: The lyrics are like a conversation with a long-time, far-away friend.
sentences.zh: 歌词就像是与一位远方的老友在交谈。

sentences.en: The song is a very complex composition, bouncing off its baseline, but it feels spontaneous, like anything can happen.
sentences.zh: 这首歌的编曲非常复杂，随着低音线条跳动，但感觉又很即兴，仿佛一切皆有可能。

sentences.en: Maybe I could run away someplace near the sea
sentences.zh: 也许我可以逃到海边某个地方

sentences.en: I'm young, I could start again
sentences.zh: 我还年轻，我可以重新开始

sentences.en: That was Iris by FEO.
sentences.zh: 以上是FEO的《Iris》。

sentences.en: Back in 1979, New York's Lower East Side was dirty, smelly, and threatening.
sentences.zh: 回到1979年，纽约下东区又脏、又臭，还充满威胁。

sentences.en: But rents were cheap and artists took advantage.
sentences.zh: 但房租便宜，艺术家们便利用了这一点。

sentences.en: There was a lot of creativity downtown.
sentences.zh: 市中心充满了创造力。

sentences.en: Bush Tetras formed in 1979 and they completely distilled that vibe.
sentences.zh: Bush Tetras乐队成立于1979年，他们完美地提炼了那种氛围。

sentences.en: Tough, funky, down-to-earth, trusting no one.
sentences.zh: 强硬、时髦、脚踏实地，不信任任何人。

sentences.en: Now the two surviving founders of the band, guitarist Pat Place and singer Cynthia Slay, have revved up Bush Tetras again, with Steve Shelley from Sonic Youth on druMs.
sentences.zh: 现在，乐队的两名健在创始人，吉他手帕特·普莱斯和歌手辛西娅·斯莱，与来自Sonic Youth乐队的鼓手史蒂夫·雪莱一起，让Bush Tetras重获新生。

sentences.en: This song, Things I Put Together, is scrappy and funky and self-aware.
sentences.zh: 这首歌《Things I Put Together》既粗犷又时髦，且充满自我意识。

sentences.en: The song insists that building things is important, even if they don't laSt.
sentences.zh: 这首歌坚持认为，创造事物至关重要，哪怕它们无法长久存在。

sentences.en: Here's Things I Put Together by Bush Tetras.
sentences.zh: 接下来是 Bush Tetras 乐队带来的《Things I Put Together》。

sentences.en: Finally, let's listen to one of my all-time favorite instruments, the steel drum.
sentences.zh: 最后，让我们来听听我最喜欢的乐器之一：钢鼓。

sentences.en: It's percussive, but it can sustain melodies.
sentences.zh: 它既有打击乐的质感，又能演奏出持续的旋律。

sentences.en: If you ever have a chance to go hear a Trinidadian steel drum orchestra live, go for it.
sentences.zh: 如果你有机会现场聆听特立尼达钢鼓乐团的演奏，一定要去。

sentences.en: Recordings just do not capture that sonic joy.
sentences.zh: 录音作品根本无法捕捉到那种声音带来的愉悦感。

sentences.en: But here's an avant-garde, analytical approach to the steel drum.
sentences.zh: 不过，这里有一首以前卫、分析视角演绎钢鼓的作品。

sentences.en: Olaf Dreher was half of The Knife, the electronic group from Sweden.
sentences.zh: Olaf Dreher 曾是瑞典电子乐队 The Knife 的成员之一。

sentences.en: He and the fellow electronic musician, Mount Sims, have collaborated on an album built from realistic and electronically tweaked steel drum sounds.
sentences.zh: 他和另一位电子音乐人 Mount Sims 合作了一张专辑，其中的声音由真实的钢鼓声和经过电子处理的钢鼓声构建而成。

sentences.en: Hybrid Fruit is an eight-minute instrumental that holds a steady pace but keeps changing.
sentences.zh: 《Hybrid Fruit》是一首八分钟的器乐曲，节奏平稳却不断变化。

sentences.en: It's minimalist and systematic, but it feels oh-so-human.
sentences.zh: 它极简且有条理，却又让人感到无比人性化。

sentences.en: That was Hybrid Fruit by Olaf Dreher and Mount SiMs.
sentences.zh: 刚才那首是 Olaf Dreher 和 Mount Sims 创作的《Hybrid Fruit》。

sentences.en: I'm John Pirellis.
sentences.zh: 我是 John Pirellis。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听。

sentences.en: For more NYT shorts from my very smart colleagues at The Times, get our new audio app.
sentences.zh: 想收听更多来自《纽约时报》聪明同事们的短音频，请下载我们的新音频应用。

sentences.en: It's available for free to New York Times All Access and News subscribers.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》全通版和新闻订阅用户可免费使用。

sentences.en: Download the app at nytimes.com slash audio app.
sentences.zh: 请前往 nytimes.com/audioapp 下载该应用。

sentences.en: This episode was produced by Tina Antolini, Elissa Dudley, and Crystal Duhame.
sentences.zh: 本期节目由 Tina Antolini、Elissa Dudley 和 Crystal Duhame 制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Wendy Doerr and engineered by Rowan Niemestow, Corey Schruppel, Daniel Farrell, and Sophia Landman.
sentences.zh: 由 Wendy Doerr 编辑，Rowan Niemestow、Corey Schruppel、Daniel Farrell 和 Sophia Landman 负责工程。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Paula Schumann and Sam Dolnik.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢 Paula Schumann 和 Sam Dolnik。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening, and I'll meet you back here Saturday.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听，我们周六再见。

sentences.en: I'm certainly not as good-looking as Michael Bavaro, but you can't tell that on radio.
sentences.zh: 我当然没有 Michael Bavaro 那么帅，但广播里又看不出来。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter Show》节目，我们将为您准备假日待客指南。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要全黑的睡眠环境吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝醉了才睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这可是非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用或你喜欢的任何播客平台收听《Wirecutter Show》。

sentences.en: Do they have any passion?
